assessment.behaviour_change: EditorComponent.ngOnInit now loads the article and checks the author only when the route has a slug. Before, /editor (new article) called GET /api/articles/undefined and the author check, which broke the New Article page. ShowAuthedDirective now creates its view only once (it guards on authRef), so it no longer duplicates the embedded view on repeated auth emissions. authRef is never reset after clear(), so a logout followed by a login may not re-render the content. Re-test that.
